title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Liability Terms by Debt Type
content:
Two liability terms in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** differ by debt type: whether a release of liability on an assumed home loan bars a guaranty debt against the veteran, and whether the debt can be split between the student and the school.

| Debt type | Release of liability on an assumed loan bars a guaranty debt against the veteran | Debt can be split between the student and the school |
|---|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | No | No |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | No | No |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | No | Yes |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | No | No |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | No | No |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | Yes | No |

**Reading the table.** The release-of-liability term is Yes only for the Home Loan Guaranty Debt, the one type that arises from a paid guaranty claim. The student-and-school split is Yes only for the Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment; every other type is the debtor's alone.
